basics.name: Juan C. Beaver
basics.label: Firmware & Embedded Engineer
basics.summary: Embedded engineer focused on sensing, motion control, and instrumentation. Builds concept-to-validation test setups (fixtures, automation, data), MCU firmware, DAQ chains, custom PCB interface boards, and Python automation/GUI tools.

work.name: Case Western Reserve University
work.summary: Led concept-to-validation development of instrumentation and embedded systems across four research projects spanning sensing, motion control, haptics, and computer vision.
highlights: Designed a custom LVDT read-out board in KiCad achieving sub-micron displacement with < 5 µV RMS noise at 300 Hz sampling.
Wrote MCU + Python/GUI software for acquisition, filtering, logging, and closed-loop motion control with PID-tuned DC motor control.
Built a motorized capture rig (ESP32 + stepper driver) with Structure-from-Motion pipeline for 3D arm mesh reconstruction.
Integrated OpenHaptics and CHAI3D for a virtual environment with tuned force-feedback control.
Built a CNN-based vision model for surgical force estimation; co-authored publication in Journal of Medical Robotics Research (2024).
Curated and optimized a 200,000+ image dataset; built Amazon Mechanical Turk GUI for ground-truth labeling.

work.name: Raytheon Technologies
work.summary: Collaborated with aspiring engineers and industry professionals to create and maintain a dynamic learning environment.
highlights: Refined experience program content and drove active participation.
Collaborated with industry professionals to improve the facilitator curriculum.

work.name: Design For America
work.summary: Led a 5–7 person team delivering accessible play devices for children with cerebral palsy.
highlights: Built an adaptive RC controller: microcontroller drives OEM board inputs, up to four 3.5 mm switches, USB-powered, in a 3D-printed enclosure.
Worked with United Cerebral Palsy to test with kids and deployed 3 controllers over one semester.

projects.name: Tonometry / Poroelasticity Measurement Device
projects.description: Proof-of-concept instrument to characterize poroelastic properties of limbs for lymphedema/edema monitoring. Custom LVDT readout PCB in KiCad with sub-micron displacement at < 5 µV RMS noise.
highlights: KiCad PCB design (ADC + MCU + analog filtering)
Python/GUI for acquisition, filtering, and closed-loop motion control
PID-tuned DC motor control for low-disturbance weight placement

projects.name: Morphometric Limb Scanning Device
projects.description: Motorized capture rig (ESP32 + stepper driver) with Structure-from-Motion pipeline to reconstruct 3D arm meshes for at-home volumetric tracking.
highlights: ESP32 firmware + stepper motor driver
Fusion 360/Onshape mechanical mounts
SfM 3D reconstruction pipeline

projects.name: Dual-Extruder 3D Printer
projects.description: Dual-toolhead/toolchanger stack with Klipper on an STM32H723 controller with custom macros and TMC5160 driver tuning.
highlights: Klipper macros for tool select, safe homing, and BLTouch bed routines
TMC5160 SPI driver tuning
Log-driven motion calibration diagnostics

projects.name: VibeCane (Haptic Navigation Assistive Cane)
projects.description: Raspberry Pi Pico powered assistive cane for visually impaired users. Ultrasonic arrays detect obstacles in a 170-degree cone and drop-offs; mapped to haptic motors on the handle and a wearable bracelet.
highlights: RP2040 firmware
Ultrasonic sensor array for obstacle detection
Haptic motor feedback system

projects.name: 3D Printed Fingertip Haptic Device
projects.description: Virtual environment with tuned force-feedback control using OpenHaptics and CHAI3D, with serial communication to a microcontroller-based manipulator.
highlights: OpenHaptics + CHAI3D integration
Force-feedback control tuning
Serial MCU communication
